Patch 0.31.22 (Merchant shop uses shared layout classes)

  • The Merchant shop shell now uses reusable classes: Window sizing, centering, z-index, flex layout, and overflow rules now live in shared window CSS.
  • Shop content panes have named layout classes: Main shop and buyback panes now share scrollable content styling, guidance copy styling, mystery-box grid layout, and buyback grid sizing.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass continues through service windows: Split Stack cleanup now extends into the Merchant shop flow.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for Merchant shop shell/content classes and removed the old inline shop layout styling.

Patch 0.31.21 (Split Stack dialog uses shared classes)

  • The Split Stack dialog now uses reusable classes: The modal shell, scrollable content, item label, controls, and action row now share window CSS instead of inline HTML chrome.
  • Split controls have centralized sizing: Range width, number input sizing, field colors, borders, padding, and row spacing now live with the rest of the window styles.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass continues through inventory workflows: Inventory footer cleanup now extends into stack management.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for Split Stack classes and removed the old inline dialog styling.

Patch 0.31.20 (Inventory footer uses shared classes)

  • The inventory footer now uses reusable classes: The sort row, sort button, gold display, and starter guidance now share inventory CSS instead of inline HTML chrome.
  • Inventory copy styling has been centralized: Footer spacing, button treatment, gold text, guidance color, line height, alignment, and separators now live in window CSS.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass continues through core bag flow: Skill Tree placeholder cleanup now extends into the inventory management surface.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for inventory footer classes and removed the old inline inventory footer styling.

Patch 0.31.19 (Skill Tree empty state uses a shared class)

  • The Skill Tree empty state now uses a reusable class: The fallback message for selecting a class now shares skill-tree CSS instead of inline HTML chrome.
  • Inline Skill Tree copy styling has been reduced: Center alignment, muted copy color, and top spacing now live beside the rest of the Skill Tree styles.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass continues through secondary HUD surfaces: The spellbook cleanup now extends into the Skill Tree placeholder state.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for the Skill Tree empty-state class and removed the old inline placeholder styling.

Patch 0.31.18 (Abilities menu shell uses shared classes)

  • The Abilities menu shell now uses reusable classes: The spellbook window keeps its centered, viewport-safe layout in shared CSS instead of inline HTML chrome.
  • The spell grid now has a named content class: Padding, four-column layout, tile gaps, minimum height, and scroll behavior now live in window CSS.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass continues through HUD windows: Active ability tooltip cleanup now extends into the Abilities spellbook menu.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for the Abilities menu shell/content classes and removed inline layout styling.

Patch 0.31.17 (Ability tooltip text uses shared classes)

  • Ability tooltip text now uses reusable classes: The compact ability name, description, and mana-cost rows now share ability-tooltip classes.
  • Inline tooltip text chrome has been reduced: Tooltip title spacing, gold title color, description sizing, muted copy color, cost color, and cost spacing now live in abilities CSS.
  • The 0.31 consistency pass starts moving into HUD micro-surfaces: The start flow and loading overlay cleanup now extends into the active ability tooltip.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for ability tooltip text classes and removed inline ability tooltip text styling.

Patch 0.31.16 (Loading overlay uses shared classes)

  • Loading overlay chrome now uses reusable classes: The loading screen shell, title, progress frame, progress fill, and status text now share loading-screen classes.
  • Inline loading styles have been reduced: Fullscreen overlay positioning, centered layout, title color, progress sizing, bar transition, and status typography now live in overlay CSS.
  • The 0.31 entry-surface cleanup now covers transition feedback: Login, class selection, and loading states all move toward reusable class-based styling.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for loading overlay classes and removed inline loading-screen progress chrome.

Patch 0.31.15 (Class selection descriptions use shared classes)

  • Class-selection copy now uses reusable classes: The create-character title and each class fantasy description now share class-selection title, description, and class-color modifier classes.
  • Inline class-selection chrome has been reduced: Shared width, alignment, spacing, font sizing, and class-specific description colors now live in start-screen CSS.
  • The 0.31 entry-surface cleanup now covers the whole start flow: Version, first steps, auth, enter-world, and class-pick guidance all use class-based styling.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for class-selection title/description/modifier classes and removed inline class-pick guidance chrome.

Patch 0.31.14 (Auth entry controls use shared classes)

  • Login and enter-world controls now use reusable classes: Auth title, auth action row, fill-width auth buttons, auth status text, and the play container button now share named start-screen classes.
  • Inline auth chrome has been reduced: Login title typography, auth button flex, status color and sizing, play container layout, and enter-world button emphasis now live in start-screen CSS.
  • The 0.31 entry-surface cleanup keeps moving downward: Start screen version, first-step guidance, login controls, and enter-world affordance now follow the same class-based styling direction.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for auth panel and play container classes and removed inline auth/enter-world chrome.

Patch 0.31.13 (Start flow panel uses shared classes)

  • First Steps panel chrome now uses reusable classes: The start-flow shell, body, title, copy, and step text now share named start-flow-panel classes.
  • Inline onboarding panel styling has been reduced: Positioning, width, margin, flex layout, body padding, title emphasis, copy color, and step typography now live in start-screen CSS.
  • The 0.31 entry-surface cleanup continues: The login screen now treats its version row and onboarding guidance as reusable styling surfaces instead of one-off inline blocks.
  • Regression coverage: Added coverage for start-flow panel shell/body/text classes and removed inline first-steps panel chrome.
